<script>
/* Impress Tiling & Waterproofing
   "Under the tile" reveal slider. */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var CSS =
    '.lv-stage{-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;cursor:ew-resize;touch-action:pan-y}' +
    '.lv-stage .lv-im,.lv-stage .lv-pane,.lv-stage img,.lv-stage svg{' +
      '-webkit-user-drag:none;user-drag:none}' +
    '.lv-stage .lv-range{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;width:100%;height:100%;' +
      'margin:0;padding:0;border:0;opacity:0;background:transparent;' +
      '-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;pointer-events:none}';

  function addCss() {
    if (document.getElementById('lv-reveal-css')) { return; }
    var s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'lv-reveal-css';
    s.textContent = CSS;
    (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);
  }

  function bind(stage) {
    if (!stage || stage.getAttribute('data-reveal-ready') === '1') { return; }
    stage.setAttribute('data-reveal-ready', '1');

    var range = stage.querySelector('.lv-range');
    if (!range) {
      range = document.createElement('input');
      range.className = 'lv-range';
      range.type = 'range';
      range.min = '8';
      range.max = '70';
      range.step = '1';
      range.value = '46';
      range.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Reveal what sits beneath the tiled floor. ' +
                                       'Move right to open the section.');
      stage.insertBefore(range, stage.firstChild);
    }
    if (window.getComputedStyle(stage).position === 'static') {
      stage.style.position = 'relative';
    }

    function apply() { stage.style.setProperty('--p', range.value + '%'); }

    function setFromX(clientX) {
      var r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!r.width) { return; }
      var lo = Number(range.min), hi = Number(range.max);
      if (isNaN(lo)) { lo = 0; }
      if (isNaN(hi)) { hi = 100; }
      var pct = Math.round(((clientX - r.left) / r.width) * 100);
      range.value = String(Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, pct)));
      apply();
    }

    range.addEventListener('input', apply);
    range.addEventListener('change', apply);

    var active = null;

    stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
      if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0) { return; }
      active = e.pointerId;
      if (e.cancelable) { e.preventDefault(); }
      if (stage.setPointerCapture) {
        try { stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
      }
      try { range.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (err) {}
      setFromX(e.clientX);
    });

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
      if (active !== null && e.pointerId === active) { setFromX(e.clientX); }
    });
    function release(e) {
      if (active !== null && e.pointerId === active) { active = null; }
    }
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', release);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', release);
    window.addEventListener('blur', function () { active = null; });

    stage.addEventListener('dragstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
    stage.addEventListener('selectstart', function (e) {
      if (active !== null && e.cancelable) { e.preventDefault(); }
    });

    apply();
  }

  function scan() {
    addCss();
    var found = document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal], .lv-stage');
    for (var i = 0; i < found.length; i++) { bind(found[i]); }
    return found.length;
  }

  function go() {
    if (scan()) { return; }
    if (!window.MutationObserver) { return; }
    var mo = new MutationObserver(function () { if (scan()) { mo.disconnect(); } });
    mo.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function () { mo.disconnect(); }, 15000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', go);
  } else {
    go();
  }
}());
</script>
